(Currently amended) Claim 1: A computer-implemented method for trading combinations of financial instruments, said method comprising: receiving, during a selected time period, combination orders to trade financial instruments; storing each eligible received combination order, wherein a received combination order is eligible if it satisfies at least one selected condition, wherein said at least one selected condition includes the necessary condition that all financial instruments specified by the legs of an eligible order are in a set of two or more selected financial instruments; and processing eligible orders or expanded eligible orders using a combinatorial matching algorithm (CMA) executed by a computer, wherein said processing begins at a selected time.

(Currently amended) Claim 14: A computer-implemented method for trading combinations of financial instruments, said method comprising: receiving, during a first selected time period, combination orders to trade financial instruments; storing each eligible received combination order, wherein a received combination order is eligible if it satisfies at least one selected condition, wherein said at least one selected condition includes the necessary condition that all financial instruments specified by the legs of an eligible order are in a set of two or more selected financial instruments; and processing eligible or expanded eligible orders using a combinatorial matching algorithm (CMA) executed by a computer, wherein said processing begins at a selected time, wherein said CMA is not constrained by limit prices, and wherein said CMA is based on one of the following: a forward matching algorithm (FMA), and a reverse elimination algorithm (REA).

(Cancelled) Claim 13: The method of claim 1, further comprising one of the following: computer-executable software, transmitted as an information signal, for causing a computer to implement the steps of said method; and a computer-readable medium having computer-executable instructions stored thereon for causing a computer to implement the steps of said method.

(Currently amended) Claim 23: A computer-based system for trading combinations of financial instruments, said system comprising: a computer system configured to obtain combination orders to trade financial instruments; and a computer system configured to obtain a matched collection of expanded eligible orders, wherein an obtained order is eligible if it satisfies at least one selected condition, and wherein said at least one selected condition includes the necessary condition that all financial instruments specified by the legs of an eligible order are in a set of two or more selected financial instruments.

(Currently amended) Claim 24: The system of claim 23, further comprising a computer system configured to increase, at least in principle, the quality of said matched collection. 

(Currently amended) Claim 25: The system of claim 23, further comprising a computer system configured to provide additional trading functionality.
